description: Let your agent read and monitor Telegram channels — posts, captions, link previews, and comments from public or private channels — and turn them into digests, summaries, and alerts. Unread tracking, JSON or text output, SOCKS5-proxy support, and a guided login the agent can run for the user. MTProto
